tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bod kyi rgyal po khri bdun ldeng gcig dang*// legs drug lde brgyad btsan bzhi zhes bya ste// nyi shu rtsa drug sngon gyi rgyal po yin// skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu drug dang*// shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bzhi// de ltar gdung rabs bzhi bcu tham pa ste// de yis bod 'bangs spyi yi skyid res khyer// 'on kyang dam chos dar las 'grib pa med// rje lde gnya' khri btsan po deng khri btsan po dang*// mu khri btsan po pri khri btsan po dang*// gdags khri btsan po khris ye btsan po dang*// gri gum btsan po gnam gyi khri bdun yin// spu lde gung rgyal ldeng gcig bya ba'o// ngo legs 'og rgyu legs dang sho legs dang*// 'bro zhing legs dang i sho legs dang ni// gcen ring gnam zi legs ni zhal snga bgyi// gcung zi gnam zi legs te legs drug go /lde ma nam/ 'phrul po gzhung btsan/ lto snam bum/ lho snol nam/ lde snol po/ lde se snol lam/ lde se rnal po/ lde rgyal po ste brgyad do// rgyal tho lo sa btsan/ de man chad 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te la lam sde/ bza' khri rgyal na bu/ bzhes pa'i sras khri btsan nam/ des sman bza' klu rgyal dbang bzhes pa'i sras khri sgra yungs btsan/ des sman bza' klu rgyal dbang bzhes pa'i sras khri thog rje/ thog btsan te btsan bzhi'o// de yan chad mi rje mdzad nas gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa drug thal lo// des ru gyong bza' steng rgya mtsho ma bzhes pa'i sras tho tho ri snyan btsan/ des dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes te pang kong phyag brgya pa dang*/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa dang*/ yi ge drug pa dang*/ tsin+tā ma ṇi'i kol phor nam mkha' la byon/ des lha lung bza' ma mo rje bzhes pa'i sras khri gnyen bzung btsan/ des 'brom bza' byang gnyen te pa bzhes pa'i sras 'bro gnyen lde ru/

des mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan pu 'tsho ba bzhes pa'i sras rgyal stag ri gnyen gzigs/ des bol gol bza' stong btsun gyi 'bro sman bzhes pa'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ des tshe spong bza' 'bri ma tog this skong bzhes pa'i sras srong btsan sgam po/ des btsun mo gsum las/ mo bza' khri mo gnyan gyi sras/ gung srong gung btsan/ de'i zhal 'bros byas te yab kyi sngon du 'das pas phyed ces bgyi'o// des wa zhwa bza' mang po rje bzhes pa'i sras mang srong mang btsan/ de'i zhang tshe spong gis bgyi'o// des 'bro pa khri chen khri ma lod kyi sras dur srong mang po rje rlung nam/ des mchims bza' mtshams me tog bzhes pa'i sras me khri lde gtsug brtan/ skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu// btsan lngar byed na ma dag ste// 'on kyang phyed dang bcu lags so// shin tu skyid pa'i rgyal rabs phyed dang bzhi ni me khri ldes btsun mo drug bzhes pa las/ rgya rje yag 'byam gyi sras mo gyim phya gon ju'i sras khri srong lde btsan/ des btsun mo bzhes pa'i tshe spong bza' rma rgyal mtsho skar ma la sras bzhi 'khrungs te mu khri btsan po gzhon pa la gshegs/ mu tig btsan po thar pa la gshegs/ mu ne btsan pos rgyal sa lo gcig zla ba dgu byas nas yum gyis bkrongs pas phyed ces bya'o// khri lde srong btsan gyis rgyal sa bzung ngo*// des 'bro bza' lha rgyal gung skar ma bzhes pa'i sras gsum gyi che ba khri btsan ma/ lho bum thang du bcug nas 'brom bza' legs rje dang*/ sna nam bza' me rje the'u dug gis bkrongs/ glang dar ma sprel mgo mi sdug pa glen pas rgyal sar ma bton/ chung ba khri gtsug lde ral pa can gyis te shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bzhi lags so// de yan chad mi rje mdzad nas rgyal po'i rabs bcu la mu ne dang khri lde gnyis mched lags pas gdung rabs so dgu lags so// dam pa chos kyi dbu rnyed nas rgyal po'i rabs bcu bzhi lags so// yang brjod par bya ste/

dang po rgyal po gang du 'khrungs pa dang*/ yab dang ji srid 'grogs pa dang*/ tshe yi tshad dang rgyal sa ji tsam bzung ba dang*/ gang du 'das sa rnams gzhung 'di bstan par bya ste/ 'on kyang gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la ni de zhib tshegs gzhung nas bstan pa med/ 'on kyang mi rje mdzad nas gdung rab nyi shu rtsa drug la/ drug brgya dang drug cu rtsa drug thal/ dam pa'i chos dbu rnyed nas ni gdung rabs lnga la lo grangs brgya dang lnga bcu thal zer/ srong btsan sgam po me mo glang gi lo la 'khrungs/ spyan ras gzigs te bcu gsum lon nas yab 'das nas chab srid lo grangs drug cu dgur bzung nas spyir lo brgyad cu gya gnyis nas 'phrul snang bcu gcig zhal la thim skad/ 'phan yul zal mo sgang du 'das kyang zer// nges par thugs rje chen po lags pas na// spyan ras gzigs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gung srong bcu gsum bzhes nas chab srid ni// lo lngar bzung ste bco brgyad lon nas 'das// slar yang yab kyi rgyal srid bzung ngo skad// me pho khyi la mang srong 'khrungs nas ni// lo skor gcig nas mes 'das mang srong des// bco lngar srid bzung nyi shu rtsa bdun dpyid// rtsang gi bar snang zhes byar 'das so skad// dur srong ma bltams pa nas yab 'das te// chu pho byi ba'i lo la bsgrags su bltams// cig car srid bzung nyi shu rtsa dgu na// 'jang gi yul du 'das te pur gnyer ni// cog gru khong khri dag gis bgyis so skad// khri lde gtsug brtan lcags 'brug dpyid kyi dus// pho brang ldan dkar 'das te lo gzhug la// yab 'das cig car srid zung dgung lo ni// drug cu rtsa gsum bzhes nas chu rta la// yar 'brog sbas pa bya bar 'das so skad// khri srong lcags rta'i dpyid ka brag dmar du// 'khrungs nas bcu gsum lon nas yab 'das te// cig car srid bzhes bzhi bcu rtsa gsum bzung*// lnga bcu rtsa drug lon te shing glang la// zung 'phrang nang du 'das zhes gsal bar thos// mu ni btsan po chu stag brag dmar 'khrungs// rtsa lnga lon nas srid bzung lo gcig dang*// zla dgu srid bzung spun phur yum gyis bkrongs// gcung po khri lde srong btsan shing 'brug ston// brag dmar du 'khrungs nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas// gcen grong rgyal srid sum cu so gcig bzung*// spyir lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa na// me bya'i ston kar sgrags kyi phur 'das so// khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can zhes pa// me pho khyi la 'o cang de 'ur bltams// gsum gyi gcung po yon tan ldan pa 'di// bcu gnyis lon nas yab 'das rgyal sar bton// nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyal sa bzung ba las// 'dzam gling sum gnyis dag gi rgyal po bgyis// rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa 'di// lcags bya sum cu rtsa drug 'das so skad// chu pho rta la khri srong rgyal sa bzung*// lcags mo bya la khri gtsug lde btsan 'das// de yi bar la dgu bcu go dgu ru// dam chos shin tu dar te skyid pa'i rabs// de nas dam chos khrims bsnubs rgyal srid nyams// chos kyi dbu g.yogs glang dar rgyud la smin// bod spyi khur ba med de sil bur gyur// dam chos nub kyang rim gyis dar bar 'gyur// gsum gyi gcen po rtsang ma lcags pho dbyug

/rgyal srid ma bzung lho brag bum thang du// 'bro bza' legs rje sna nam mang mo rjes// dug gis bkrongs te de yi srid rgyud bzhugs// bar pa glang dar sprel mgo chu mo lug /bco lnga lon tshe yab 'das bcu dgu la// gcung 'das de nas rgyal srid bzung nas ni// zla ba drug tu tshul ngan rgyal po byas// lcags mo bya yi mjug tu dam chos bsnubs// de nas zla ba phyed dang bdun dag tu// sdig rgyal byas te de dag spyir bsdams nas// lo gcig zla phyed bgyis te khyi lo la// byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi rdo rjes bsad// 'od srungs yum brtan dag ni spun yin te// 'od srungs chu mo phag la spur phur skyes// de ma thag tu srid bzung lo gsum na// shing mo glang la yar lung sa 'phangs 'das// yum brtan sum cu drug la shi zhes zer// de gnyis ring nas dus ngan mgo tshugs so// phyi yi so ka shor nas bod nang 'khrugs// pha phad gsum po de la btsog pa med// dpal 'khor chu mo glang la 'phangs dar 'khrungs// bcu gsum bzhes nas yab 'das de nas ni// bco brgyad rgyal srid bzung ba'i bar la ni// gtsug lag khang brgya bzhengs shing chos la gus// mes kyi spyod pa dag la shin tu smad// so gcig chu lug yar lung shar por grong*// de nas bod kyi khrims 'khrugs dus nyams te// sa mo glang la khyeng log byung ngo skad// me mo bya la bang so'i dur rnams brus// dpal 'khor sras gnyis stod smad gnyis su gyes// yab mched drug gis rgyal sa khong bur bzung*// yang smras pa/ khri yer btsan po'i ring la/ srung dang sdom dang*/ gnam bon po gshin po che chung byung*/ dri gum btsan po grongs nas spu lde gung rgyal gyi ring la zhang zhung dang*/ sru sha'i bon pos gshin gyi dur bon byung*/ tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu rnyed/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi ring la rgya nag nas rtsis byung*/

srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dam pa chos kyi srol btod/ mtha' bzhi lho bal phal che ba dbang du 'dus nas mkhos chen po drug mdzad skad/ khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/ dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ khri lde srong btsan gyi ring la skad gsar chad kyis dam pa'i chos gtan la phab/ yab sras de gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs/ khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi sku ring la gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad brtsigs lags so// dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras gnyis kyi che ba/ bkra shis brtsegs pa btsan gyi bu gsum gyi che ba dpal sde'i rgyud ni/ gung thang pa/ klu rgyal ba/ spyi pa/ lha rtse ba/ glang lung brtsad skor ba rnams yin no// bar pa 'od sde'i rgyud ni/ grom pa/ srad pa/ nyang stod pa/ yar lung gi lha chen dpal 'bar la sogs pa yin no// chung bskyid sde'i rgyud ni/ mus pa/ 'jad pa/ nyan stod na rtog 'ga' yod/ dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras chung ba/ khri skyid lding gi bu gsum gyi che ba/ dpal gyi mgon gyi rgyud ni/ mar yul pa lags/ bar pa bkra shis mgon gyi rgyud ni zhang zhung phyi nang dang*/ pu rong dang*/ ya rtse ba lags/ chung ba sde gtsug mgon gyi rgyud ni/ khu bu la sogs pa mon yul rnams na yod do// zhes thos so// rgyal rabs ma dag pa yang mang du mthong*/ rgyu mtshan du mas dpyad cing brtags pas dag pa 'ga' zhig kyang mthong nas/ spyir pusti gcig tsam las legs par btus te/ mdor bsdus shin tu dag pa 'di/ shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
